blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines— Senate Minority Leader Alan Peter Cayetano on Wednesday lamented that some people were “twisting” his words to make it appear that he wanted every Filipino to come up with P170,000 to help the government settle the country’s debt. As of September, the national government’s debt stood at P19.66 trillion. When the issue was raised at the start of the Senate floor deliberations on the proposed P7.2-trillion national budget for 2027, Cayetano floated the idea of allowing “generous” Filipinos to voluntarily donate P170,598.03 each to help pay off the national government’s debt. His proposal drew mixed reactions from various sectors. […]... Keep on reading: Cayetano hits 'twisting' of P170,000 donation, debt payment proposal
